cases.title: Edit Pipe on P3 with new levels updates 4 pipes and 3 pits downstream, one U takes it all back, REDO puts it back
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe cascade with U and REDO (gap plan section 3 item 7; regression C40; UX-LBL-02)
cases.expected: Select pipe P3 (10A98D), CDEDIT, answer Y to the older-version question, set the first invert 17.60 and the second 17.50, Save pipe and close; the box 'Recalculate downstream inverts' answered Yes opens the Cascade Preview; Apply says '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50). Min grade: 1:16.'; one U echoes CDEDIT; after a 12 second wait REDO says 'Everything has been redone'.
cases.why_not_unit: The real Edit Pipe window, the downstream recalculation, the invert texts, the project data and AutoCAD's undo stack all take part; only a live drawing shows that one U undoes the whole cascade and that REDO is still available.
not_automated: THE INVERT TEXT VALUES AFTER U AND AFTER REDO ARE NOT READ (card C40 assertion 2): the handles of the linked invert texts were never recorded, so a command echo is the only evidence that U restored the old levels. The object count is compared as a weak guard.
The 'Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits' numbers come from run 47 on the same drawing context; a different count is reported as a FAIL for a person to judge.
